title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Implemented in Ireland by Trócaire, the programme contributes to outcome 5.1.3 Educators have increased confidence in using GCE methodologies with their learners and understand the links between GCE and their relevant curricula in early years, primary, post-primary and youth education. The objective is to provide educators and youth work practitioners with access to high quality GCE knowledge products. Key activities include designing and delivering resources to support educators in delivering GCE in their classroom and with youth groups.OBJECTIVES: Output 1 Educators and Youth work practitioners have access to high quality GCE knowledge products, increasingly via digital channelsOUTCOMES: Outcome 3. Educators have increased confidence in using GCE methodologies with their learners and understand the links between GCE and their relevant curricula in early years, primary, post-primary and youth education
